inputs.label: Doom WAD files (optional)
inputs.help: Your own commercial WAD files, such as DOOM.WAD or DOOM2.WAD. Without them the launcher downloads the free shareware WADs.

steps.text: Open the QuestZDoom Launcher from Library > Unknown Sources. Pick a game, and turn mods and texture packs on or off there.

notes: The guide installs both the engine and the launcher. Only v1.6.2 ships the launcher APK in the same release; older releases have the engine only, so the launcher pattern would fail on them. Mods (/sdcard/QuestZDoom/mods/) are not modelled.
